reproduce.working_directory: An empty temporary directory under the repository, so imports resolve against its go.mod.
reproduce.source_materialization: Copy old-source/*.go.txt to the same basenames without .txt; copy capture.go.txt to capture_test.go. Preserve all captured source bytes and original package importing.

environment.RETROM_OLD_ERROR_CAPTURE: An explicit output path for the captured JSON; never overwrite the checked-in golden while verifying.

reproduce.validation: Run command in this materialized directory. Compare output bytes against old-go-golden.json and verify source_sha256 first.
